_doc: The owner's prices, rates and dates (launch plan 2026-10-25, decisions L5-L8). The ONE place they live: edit here, then run `node scripts/sync-pricing.js` (rewrites supabase/functions/_shared/pricingData.ts and prints the SQL for public.pricing_config(), which a NEW migration must carry). tests/pricingConfig.test.ts fails while any copy differs. Rates are basis points (1000 = 10%), money is US cents.

blocks._doc: A block (plans.kind 'block' with duration_weeks) sells as the season's monthly installments (_shared/season.ts). default_weeks is the length the apps offer a new block (no column default: an open pass is a block with no length). A dated block (plans.starts_on) goes on sale sale_opens_days_before days before it starts (90: refund-pass refunds a payment up to 90 days old, so a coach can still refund the first payment until the block starts).

sessions._doc: A single session (plans.kind 'session') is ONE payment that never renews. The athlete cancels it themselves for a full refund until free_cancel_hours before plans.session_at (cancel-session); inside that the coach's own policy applies (trainers.cancellation_policy).

stripe_processing_estimate._doc: Stripe's standard US card price, for display arithmetic only (what comes out of the platform's fee on a destination charge). Not FitLink's number and never charged by FitLink.
